S1.title: Jaldi Kholne Ki Galti
S1.hook: Jaldi shuttering kholi toh slab baith jayegi!
S1.topic: Shuttering jaldi kholne ki galti: concrete ko set hone ka time chahiye (exact din engineer bataye)

S2.title: Column Me Chhed Kyun?
S2.hook: Column me chhed aur slurry leakage ka raaz!
S2.topic: Honeycombing: column mein chhed kyun aate hain (vibration kam, gap se slurry bah gayi)

S5.title: Balli Ki Doori Ka Khel
S5.hook: Slab latak gaya? Dekho balli ki sahi doori!
S5.topic: Balli ki doori: props door door lage to slab latak jaata hai (spacing engineer se confirm)
